name: Active
tooltip: You cannot use the Prepare action on this ability.

name: Aid
tooltip: Abilities with the Aid keyword can only be used on allies, unless the ability specifically states you can use it on yourself.

name: Artillery
tooltip: The attack can target non-hidden units behind cover (even full cover) and any cover is calculated from above the target rather than from your position to the target.

name: Augment
tooltip: An attack that has been modified by an Augment effect cannot be modified again and given another Augment effect.

name: Blanketing
tooltip: When you make an attack against multiple targets with this ability, roll one accuracy and damage check that applies against all targets.

name: Bleeding
tooltip: You take 1d6 true damage at the start of your turn.

name: Blinded
tooltip: Blinded characters suffer a -X penalty to their accuracy rolls where X is the blinded value. If they are Blinded for 3 or higher, they cannot make any ranged attacks without first locating a target through another means than sight. If they are blinded for 5 or higher, they also cannot gain Sure Hit

name: Block Crush
tooltip: Block Crush attacks ignore any additional Guard gained from the Block action.

name: Broken
tooltip: Only applies to equipment. Armor and shields that are broken provide no benefit or negatives. Weapons that are broken can only be used as an improvised weapon.

name: Burning
tooltip: A Burning character takes X damage at the end of their turn. They may spend 1 AP to remove this effect.

name: Challenge
tooltip: If a challenged character does not include the challenger as a target when making an attack, they provoke a melee attack of opportunity from the challenger. This does not trigger if the challenged target makes an attack of opportunity or if the challenger is not a target due effects such as charm.

name: Charm
tooltip: The target must make a Save or be charmed by you until the end of the encounter.

name: Circuit
tooltip: The first time each combat you use an ability with this keyword, the mana cost is reduced by 1. Afterwards, this mana cost reduction is removed from all abilities with this keyword.

name: Combo
tooltip: Combo abilities gain a bonus when used directly after another ability. Combo abilities remain valid until you spend AP on a different ability or action.

name: Concentration
tooltip: A character can only have 1 Concentration effect active at the same time. They may drop a Concentration effect during their turn for 0 AP. When a character gets Downed, they lose Concentration.

name: Crushing
tooltip: On an unblocked hit, this attack deals a minimum damage equal to your Power.

name: Daze
tooltip: You immediately lose 1 AP. If you do not have any AP, you instead regen 1 less AP at the start of your next turn. A dazed target becomes immune to Daze until the end of their next turn.

name: Disarm
tooltip: When disarmed, you cannot make weapon attacks with the weapon you were wielding when you got disarmed. You must draw the weapon again to use it when the Disarm ends. Unarmed attacks are unaffected by Disarm.

name: Divine
tooltip: If you took the Divine's Chosen breakthrough, this ability's damage type becomes your chosen divine's damage type instead of Holy.

name: Domain
tooltip: A domain area spell. Only one domain area may be active at a location at a time.

name: Enchantment
tooltip: An enchantment is placed on a weapon. A weapon can only have 1 enchantment at the same time. If an enchantment is placed on a channeling weapon, it transfer the enchantment properties to any spells cast while holding it.

name: Esoteric Art
tooltip: You can only use 1 ability with this keyword or with the Secret Art keyword per encounter.

name: Expose
tooltip: The target's crit threshold is reduced by the expose value (base 1, reducing normal crit threshold from 20→19). name: Fire
tooltip: Spells and attacks that deal Fire damage may ignite flammable, unattended objects.

name: Flashback
tooltip: Flashbacks are abilities that refer to an earlier time in the campaign. They reflect prior planning that the character has made to affect the current situation.

name: Full Pierce
tooltip: Full pierce attacks cannot be reduced by guard.

name: Half Pierce
tooltip: Half Pierce attacks ignore Guard, unless the target takes the Block action or Dodge action.

name: Half Rapid
tooltip: This ability may be used once on each creature every round.

name: Hellfire
tooltip: Hellfire functions like Burning (You take X damage at the end of your turn), but it can no longer be removed the normal way if not removed before the end of the target’s next turn. It can still be dispelled through the use of abilities. Hellfire can be applied to enemies immune to Burning, but it ca

name: Hiding
tooltip: While in Hiding, enemies cannot see or target you and even if they are aware of your presence, they cannot pinpoint your exact location. You lose Hiding if you move, attack or use any other ability that does not have the Stealth keyword unless that movement or attack says otherwise.

name: Illumination
tooltip: The next attack against you gets an X bonus to the accuracy roll (Consumed even on a miss).

name: Immovable
tooltip: While not flying, effects from other creatures that knock you prone or force you to move such as knockbacks are ineffective.

name: Instant
tooltip: Can be used while another action is resolving to temporarily interrupt it. The Instant ability resolves immediately and before any interrupted ability can resolve. The current action is cancelled and refunded if the target becomes invalid.

name: Isolated
tooltip: If you have no allies within 10ft of you and at least 2 enemies within 10ft of you, you are considered Isolated.

name: Killing Blow
tooltip: Killing Blow effects trigger when reducing the HP of enemy to 0 or lower. You cannot benefit from the same Killing Blow effect against the same target more than once.

name: Lock On
tooltip: Lock On attacks ignore the bonus from dodge.

name: Lockstep
tooltip: This attack always matches the target's base evasion (including bonuses etc, but they may still dodge it like normal).

name: Miracle
tooltip: A character may only cast 1 Miracle per encounter.

name: Mystic Eye
tooltip: This ability is made with a Mystic Eye.

name: Ninjutsu
tooltip: This ability requires two free hands. You may wield Small weapon, Saboteur threaded dagger, One-handed thrown and Sets of Missiles weapons and still count as having your hand free.

name: Offstep
tooltip: Attacks against you always meet your base evasion (Including bonuses etc, but you may still dodge them like normal).

name: Opener
tooltip: This ability can only be used as the first action in a turn. (Paying upkeep does not count as an action)

name: Opportunistic
tooltip: You may use this ability instead of making a regular of attack of opportunity. This ability is counted as making an attack of opportunity and you don't get your regular one if you use it.

name: Overcharge
tooltip: You may spend additional AP and/or Mana to increase the power of the ability.

name: Pass
tooltip: You can move through enemy units for this movement.

name: Persist
tooltip: This effect costs +X mana to dispel. If the creature dispelling it does not use mana, it takes +X AP (or +X RP) instead. Does not apply when they use the natural way of removing it, if possible (For example by spending 1 AP to remove a Burn).

name: Pinpoint
tooltip: You ignore points of the target's guard equal to your Focus. Cannot reduce guard below 0.

name: Presence Concealment
tooltip: By suppressing your mana output you conceal your presence, gaining Presence Concealment. name: Prone
tooltip: An ability with this keyword can be used while Prone with no penalty. All attacks without the Prone keyword cost +1 AP and RP while prone.

name: Quick
tooltip: The first time after using an ability with Quick, other abilities with Quick used in same turn cost +1 AP.

name: Rage
tooltip: This ability can be used while in Rage Stance.

name: Rapid
tooltip: This ability can be used more than once per turn.

name: Regrowth
tooltip: You use nature's power to place Regrowth on an ally that lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Root
tooltip: You cannot move and your evasion when taking the Dodge reaction is changed to 13 + Agility (rounded down)

name: Safe
tooltip: This spell and/or attack does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Sanctify
tooltip: Attacks against you that hit heal an enemy attacker by 3+the applier's focus. After this triggers, the stacks of this debuff are reduced by 1. An attacker at full HP may choose not to trigger the effect.

name: Scatter
tooltip: When you make an attack against multiple targets with this ability, roll a separate accuracy and damage check against each target.

name: Secret Art
tooltip: You can only use 1 ability with this keyword or with the Esoteric Art keyword per encounter.

name: Setup
tooltip: Setup attacks can be completed by spending AP in the following turn. While charging the attack, no other AP actions can be taken and attacks against you gain the Trick Attack keyword. You may cancel a setup attack instead of finishing it and don't need to spend the remaining AP. Setup attacks cannot

name: Shaken
tooltip: The target's maximum AP is reduced by 1.

name: Shieldbreaker
tooltip: This attack deals double damage to the HP of Shields and Temporary HP. Any carryover damage is not doubled.

name: Sickened
tooltip: When making a roll that uses Focus, Power, Agility or Toughness, they are treated as 1 lower.

name: Sidestep
tooltip: Your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunities.

name: Slow
tooltip: The target is slowed until the start of your next turn unless the target pays 1 RP to resist this effect.

name: Soaked
tooltip: A soaked target takes X additional damage when taking Lighting damage.

name: Song
tooltip: A character can only have 1 Song active at the same time.

name: Sound
tooltip: This ability's effect is based around sound. Those who can't hear it are unaffected.

name: Spell
tooltip: This ability is considered a spell. Unless stated otherwise, it will provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Stacking
tooltip: Abilities with this keyword give stacks of something. You can only gain stacks of 1 thing with this keyword a the same time. Upon gaining a stack of a different kind, your original stacks are lost.

name: Stagger
tooltip: A character inflicted with Stagger has their evasion reduced by X, where X is the Stagger value.

name: Stance
tooltip: Only 1 Stance ability can be active at the same time.

name: Static
tooltip: At the end of your next turn, you deal X lightning damage to all allies within 5ft of you.

name: Stealth
tooltip: This ability does not pull you out of Hiding. You must still be in low cover after using this ability to remain in Hiding.

name: Strafe
tooltip: You must have moved at least the Strafe distance towards the target before making an attack with this keyword.

name: Stun
tooltip: Your AP, AP recovery and RP is set to 0 when afflicted by this. When it ends, you regain any unused RP lost from this effect.

name: Summon
tooltip: This ability counts towards your maximum summon limit. You can only have 2 summons active at the same time. A summon does not count as a valid target for abilities that require a ‘willing’ ally.

name: Sunder
tooltip: A character inflicted with Sunder has their guard reduced by X, where X is the Sunder value.

name: Sure Hit
tooltip: Sure hit attacks always hit and do not require an accuracy roll, but they automatically miss against targets with full cover.

name: Teleport
tooltip: You teleport instead of moving normally. Teleportation does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity and ignores most forms of slows, roots and grapples. name: Transformation
tooltip: You can only have one transformation effect active at one time.

name: Trick Attack
tooltip: The target of the attack must spend double RP to react to a Trick Attack.

name: Type
tooltip: You can only be 1 ‘type’ at the same time.

name: Unarmed Strike
tooltip: This ability must be made with an unarmed attack.

name: Unbalanced
tooltip: Your next attack that costs AP (even 0 AP) costs 1 extra AP.

name: Upkeep
tooltip: You may choose to pay the cost at the beginning of your turn. If you don't, the effect is terminated. While downed, you cannot pay upkeep.

name: Weakened
tooltip: Your maximum AP goes down to 2 and maximum RP goes down to 1. When it ends, you regain any unused RP lost from this effect.

tooltip: A type of large spiders that has suffered from astral corruption, giving it teleportation abilities.

tooltip: To do.

tooltip: The broodmother is a giant spider that births other spiders.

name: Brute

name: Cheetah
tooltip: A spotted big cat.

name: Crystal Behemoth
tooltip: A large fiend that feeds on the purple crystals that are embedded in its skin.

tooltip: Defenders are front liners who go in first and absorb the hits for their allies. Existing in every culture and of any race, they are usually heavily armored with shields.

tooltip: Just a slime. By Nya.

tooltip: Just a fire slime. By Nya.

tooltip: Summon cost: 4 AP, 4 Mana

tooltip: A huge humanoid monster that possess some form of intelligence similar to that of a human child. They are often easily tricked by skilled manipulators who use them for their own goals.

tooltip: Summon cost: 4 AP, 4 Mana 10x10ft size

tooltip: A skeleton warrior summoned by necromancers.

tooltip: Just a slime. By Nya.

tooltip: To do.

name: Strike for the Shiny!
tooltip: You are predisposed to attack targets who are displaying the most valuable items, Crafter numerical bonuses (Focus, Power, Crafting skill) are not perceptible but things like layering for armor or alloying weapons are, You prioritize value on weapons and artifacts, but if none of that is visible the

name: Sub-Zero Body
tooltip: Your body is freezing cold. Any melee attacks made by you deal Frost damage. Any creature touching you for an extended period of time takes Heavy Frost damage at the start of their turn.

name: Summon I
tooltip: This summon has an upkeep of 1 AP per creature and counts as 1 towards your summon limit.

name: Summon II
tooltip: This creature has an upkeep of 2 AP and counts as 2 towards your summon limit.

name: Superboss Resistance
tooltip: You are immune to any status effects that would cause you to lose AP or otherwise prevent you from acting.

name: Superior Fiend Regeneration+
tooltip: You heal for Toughness x 20 at the start of your turn.

name: Surefooted
tooltip: You treat natural uneven terrain (rocks, fallen logs, etc.) as normal ground and can leap short spans (5–10ft) without costing extra movement.

name: Swarm
tooltip: You only take 1 damage for each single-target attack but can take full damage from AoE attacks. You cannot make normal attacks.

name: Swarm Tactics
tooltip: When you and other wolves move on your initiative, all of you move before making any attacks.

name: Target Rich Environment
tooltip: Swarm creatures are very fragile on their own and a single blow from any adventurer can dispatch you, so area of effect attacks and spells are especially effective against you. Each attack that is single target will do 1 damage and will take out 1 creature. AoE abilities will inflict their usual dam

name: The Blur
tooltip: Your form blurs as it moves, due to distortions it creates in space using its mana aura. You have 25 Evasion while in The Blur. When hit by an attack or when using a defensive action, you lose The Blur. While in The Blur, you are immune to damage that is triggered by evasion/dodge such as the Axe we

name: Thicc Skull
tooltip: Your skull is exceptionally hard. You are immune to Daze and non-magical Stun effects.

name: Threatening
tooltip: When making an opportunity attack, you are treated as having 4 higher Focus and Power.

name: Tiny Wings
tooltip: You can fly while moving, but fall down to the ground after your movement.

name: Tripping Pounce
tooltip: On damage by any attacks made through the Pounce ability, you knock the target Prone.

name: Vine Tentacles
tooltip: You have a melee attack range of 10ft.

name: Water Body
tooltip: Your attacks may deal Water or Physical damage. When you deal Water damage, you inflict Soaked X where X is your Power.

name: Water Type II
tooltip: You take half damage from Fire and Water attacks or damage, but you take 50% more from Lightning type attacks and damage. You are immune to Soaked, can swim at twice your speed and breathe underwater.

name: Web Hunter
tooltip: When attacking a target that is Slowed or Rooted by webs, you gain Lock-On on your basic Light and Heavy Attack.

name: Wind Body
tooltip: Your attacks may deal Physical or Wind damage. You may Sidestep 5ft after every attack.

name: Wind Type II
tooltip: You take half damage from Wind attacks or damage and gain +2 Evasion against ranged attacks.

name: Wings
tooltip: You can Fly through the air as if you were moving on land and your speed is doubled while doing so.

name: Adapt
tooltip: You may shift up to 2 stat points (except Toughness). The minimum is 3 and maximum is 9.

name: Alchemic Barrage (Backpack)
tooltip: Fires a barrage of missiles, making a light attack with arcane damage against all targets in line of sight. Has a bonus +10 to accuracy.

name: Alchemic Barrage II (Backpack)
tooltip: Mark a target at the end of this creature's turn if there is no mark. Activates again at the start of the creature's turn. Fires a barrage of light attacks equal to the amount of party members at the marked target equal to the amount of party members and then mark another target. Has a +10 to accura

name: Alchemic Flare (Body)
tooltip: Creates an area filled with explosive gas, contained by the wall of Transmute Low Wall (Body). If an area of gas already exists from a previous turn, ignite the gas into a fireball dealing heavy attack fire damage in the entire area that the gas was in. Sure Hit.

name: Ancestor's Blessing
tooltip: Upon being critically injured, you draw upon the ancestral strength of past leaders to empower and restore yourself. Restores Half of your currently missing HP and grants you 2 additional AP on your next turn.

name: Arcane Fang
tooltip: Your bite channels internal magic. You make a Light Attack that deals Arcane damage. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already Dazed, this attack instead deals an additional 8 full pierce Arcane damage as the lingering magic intensifies.

name: Arcane Net
tooltip: You place a 20x20ft net of arcane energy at a point within range. The net is considered difficult terrain for your enemies. You may spend 0 RP to cancel the net, immediately rooting all creatures within the net’s area of effect at that time until the start of your next turn.

name: Astra Beams
tooltip: You make X separate Light attacks that deal Astra damage against the target. If your Absorb Magic trait is active, you gain the Power bonus for each of these attacks and the element changes to that of the magic absorbed.

name: Backstab
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target.

name: Bandersnatch Swipe
tooltip: You swipe at the nearest enemy and toss them 30ft away in a direction of your choice. The target passes through allies for this movement, but will collide with walls. If they hit a wall, they take 1d4 true damage and are dazed until the start of your next turn.

name: Black Knight's Charge
tooltip: You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than

name: Blink
tooltip: You teleport to an empty space within range. The next basic Heavy attack you make has it AP cost reduced to 0.

name: Blizzard
tooltip: You create a blizzard in a 160ft radius centered on top of you. Any creature in the blizzard that is not immune to frost damage becomes slowed and has their vision reduced to 15ft. Having a suitable heat source nearby or otherwise being protected from the cold removes the slowed effect given by this

name: Blizzard Walker
tooltip: You Sidestep up to double your speed. Afterwards, you may stealth for 0 AP. Cannot be used in the same turn as Snow Assassin.

name: Boar Charge
tooltip: You move up to 4 times your movement speed in a straight line and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals maximum heavy damage if it hits. If it misses, the target moves out of the way and you keep charging until you’ve reached your max movement or until you hit a target or object.

name: Boar Trample
tooltip: You may move up to three times your movement in a straight line and gain Trample for this movement. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out

name: Bone Spike Shot
tooltip: You fire a spike from your mouth, making a Precise attack against the target. On damage, the target is pulled next to you in the most direct line possible. If the space next to you is blocked by another creature, the target is placed as closest to the original square as possible.

name: Bowling Roller
tooltip: You begin to quickly roll towards a target with little control. You move in a straight line towards the target, immediately stopping at the first target or large object in your path and making a Heavy attack against that target.

name: Claw Drill
tooltip: You mark an enemy within range. On the start of your next turn, you may Sidestep towards them in a direct line if possible. If you do, you may immediately make 2 light attacks against the target upon arriving.

name: Cleaving Strike
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against two different targets in range.

name: Combine
tooltip: Combine with a compatible target slime, adding HP and MP together. This can't go over the maximum, but if this results in a slime with maximum health, it restores 1 RP too.

name: Consume
tooltip: You make a light attack against the target. On hit, the target becomes rooted until they spend 1 AP, which removes all slimes that used this action. If the target took damage from this, the AP cost is increased to 2.

name: Crab Flexibility
tooltip: You Block or Dodge an attack. Then, you automatically Dodge or Block (whichever you didn't before) against the next attack.

name: Crab Grab
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until it takes at least 10 damage in one attack. Medium and smaller creatures are forced to move with the crab, but large creatures grabbed by this prevent you from moving more than 5ft away. Cannot be used against a ta

name: Crushing Presence
tooltip: You make a Light attack against all enemies within range. Against an enemy that's overburdened, this also gains Full Pierce.

name: Crystal Barrier
tooltip: You reduce the damage you take by 5 until the start of your next turn..

name: Crystal Burst
tooltip: You make a Light attack that deals Astra damage to all enemies in range. You also take that amount of true damage and your max HP is lowered by that amount. If this reduces your mana to 0, you explode and deal an additional Sure Hit & Full Pierce heavy damage to all enemies in range, after which you

name: Crystal Stomp
tooltip: You stomp the ground and create a shockwave, making a Light attack against all enemies in range.

name: Cure Body
tooltip: You heal the target for 9 + Power x 3 HP. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.

name: Darkness Shade
tooltip: If you are in a dark area, you attempt to Hide without using AP. When hiding in darkness, you may stay hidden if you are in direct Line of Sight of others. Leaving the dark area or having any source of light illuminate the area will immediately reveal you.

name: Death's Follower
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to twice your speed towards the target of the attack.

name: Defensive Curl
tooltip: You folds yourself, entering a defensive stance. While in this stance, you can use the Block reaction for 0 RP. You cannot willingly end the stance and cannot make reaction attacks while on it. The stance lasts until the end of the current creature’s turn.

name: Desync
tooltip: You teleport up to 20ft.

name: Detonate Self
tooltip: When you reach 0 HP, you will begin to explode. This explosion happens at the start of the turn of the character who triggered this effect. When it does, the Efreet may make a Heavy attack against all creatures within range.

name: Devour Corpse
tooltip: You eat a nearby corpse, instantly devouring it and removing it from the field. You gain +2 AP and your maximum AP is increased by 2 until the end of the encounter.

name: Dig Deeper
tooltip: You deal maximum Light damage to the target. If you used this ability on your previous turn, it deals double the damage it dealt last time.

name: Digestion
tooltip: You attempt to digest all targets affected by Gluttony . Dealing 20 (type) damage with sure hit and full pierce.

name: Dire Claw
tooltip: Your eyes flash into an aura sight temporarily and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals double Heavy damage, but the damage is reduced to 1 i the target blocks. If the target does not react to this attack, it gains Sure Hit.

name: Disengaging Shot
tooltip: You make a ranged weapon Heavy attack against an enemy in range that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to your speed.

name: Dive Attack
tooltip: You move up to 40ft towards a target within range and then make a Light attack against it. On damage, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for the rest of your turn and may move up to your movement speed at the end of your turn without spending AP. If this attack fails to do damage,you lose you

name: Divine Shield
tooltip: You automatically use the Block action against the next attack targeting you.

name: Draining Touch
tooltip: You touch the target and attempt to steal its strength, making a Light attack against the target. On damage, you gain a bonus to your Power for your next attack this turn equal to the target's Power. The target's Power becomes 0 until after its next attack.

name: Dream Ender
tooltip: You kill the target and regain all your HP.

name: Dream Shift
tooltip: You change your own form or the dreamscape to something that frightens or surprises the targets. All creatures within range must make a Save or become Shaken. What a creature targeted by this sees is unique to each creature.

name: Drop in pot
tooltip: Drop a creature rooted by your vine grab in your pitcher. The creature becomes stunned and takes Heavy full piercing damage at the start of its turn until you die.

name: Empower Beast
tooltip: You empower a chosen animal, granting them +2 maximum AP and AP recovery until the end of the encounter.

name: Esoteric Art: All Out
tooltip: You discard your armor and shield and focus on offense. You reduce your Guard and Block to 0, but gain an additional 2 AP per turn.

name: Evasive Maneuver II
tooltip: You may Sidestep 5ft.

name: Exousiai's Presence
tooltip: You raise the astra level in the zone by 1. All enemies within range that do not have enough resistance to negate this immediately suffer negative effects. Any creatures suffering from Astra Poisoning immediately have their Astra Poisoning worsened by 1 stage.

name: Explode Self
tooltip: You make a Precise attack that deals fire damage against all creatures within range. This attack deals Heavy damage instead of its normal damage.

name: Faewolf Flash
tooltip: You teleport in a brief glow of eerie light to any unoccupied spot within 40 ft. Your next Heavy attack this turn costs 0 AP.

name: Feast
tooltip: You prepare to eat a rooted target. When the setup finishes, you make a Heavy attack that deals maximum damage. On damage, you eat the target. The target becomes Stunned inside you. At the start of each of its turns, it takes Heavy full pierce damage until you die. Any attacks made from inside you g

name: Firebolt
tooltip: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

name: Flame Breath
tooltip: You breathe fire in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all creatures in it. On damage, a target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

name: Focus Fire
tooltip: You mark an enemy as the target until the start of your next turn. All Grunt level allies under your command must attack that target if they are able to do so without moving. They gain a +1 Power bonus to attacks against this target.

name: Focused Gaze
tooltip: The target suffers a -1 penalty to their agility. Can stack.

name: Frost Creation: Tower
tooltip: You summon a 10ft high frosty tower within range. The tower has 45 HP, 4 guard and no reactions. Attacks against the tower always hit. The tower acts at initiative 0, at the end of a round. When it does, it makes a single light attack using the your stats at every enemy within 20ft of it. This attac

name: Frosty Start
tooltip: Your initiative increases by 5. You may summon 1 tower described in ‘Frost Creation: Tower’ anywhere within range.

name: Full Petrify
tooltip: The target becomes temporarily petrified until the end of the encounter. A petrified creature has 0 AP and RP and can take no actions, but gains a guard bonus of +10. If the basilisk is not defeated at the encounter conclusion phase, the petrification becomes permanent.

name: Ghoul Bite
tooltip: You attempt to bite a target creature making a Heavy attack against them. You heal for the damage this attack deals.

name: Gluttony
tooltip: You attempt to consume a target, making a Heavy Attack against the target. On hit, the target is affected by Gluttony and becomes engulfed in slime. An engulfed target becomes Weakened . An ally can attempt to pull a consumed target from the slime with a DC20 Power Check, removing the effects of Glu

name: Go for the Throat
tooltip: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.

name: Gobbo Regeneration
tooltip: You heal yourself for 15+Toughness HP

name: Gobbo Throw Rock
tooltip: You deal 2 true damage to the target.

name: Grab
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you and the target are both Rooted. The target may spend 1 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted. If the target is grabbed by multiple enemies through this ability, spending the 1 AP will free it from all gra

name: Gravity Crash
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies within range.

name: Gravity Pull
tooltip: You pull every enemy within range up to 40ft.

name: Hallowed Ground
tooltip: You bless the ground in a 10ft radius around yourself. Allies in the blessed ground regain HP equal to their Toughness when they spend an RP. The blessed ground remains set in place, even when you move.

name: Headbutt
tooltip: On dealing damage with a melee attack, you can follow-up with a headbutt as a Light attack. On damage the target is Unbalanced.

name: Heat Wave
tooltip: All creatures within range must make a save or take Light Fire damage.

name: Homing Shot
tooltip: You make a heavy attack against the target with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.

name: Hydra Breath
tooltip: You breathe in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all targets in it. The damage type is based on the head’s element. On damage, you apply an effect based on the head’s element. The Earth head inflicts Daze for 1 turn, the Frost head inflicts Slowed for 1 turn and the Lightning head inflicts

name: Hydra Constrict
tooltip: You and the target both become rooted. The target may spend 2 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted.

name: Impale
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until the start of your next turn. Combo: If used after Black Knight’s Charge, this ability’s cost is reduced to 1 AP and the attack gains Full Pierce.

name: Improved Feint
tooltip: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target.

name: Ink Attack
tooltip: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target.

name: Inky Dodge
tooltip: You take the Dodge action against the triggering attack, then teleport up to 40ft.

name: Insect Assault
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target that deals Physical(Piercing) damage.

name: Ixilune's Command
tooltip: You move one of your Swarms up to 20ft or you may Sidestep an ally up to 20ft. You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead.

name: Ixith Swarm
tooltip: You summon a swarm of insects in a 15x15 square. Any creature except for you, a devouring swarm or a summoner contracted to you ending their turn inside of it takes Full Pierce Light damage. You may have up to two of these swarms active at the same time.

name: Jumping Bite
tooltip: You leap out from below that ground and make a Heavy attack against the target.

name: Leading Bite
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, all allied Wolves may move up to their movement speed closer to the target.

name: Leaping Strike
tooltip: You jump to a target within range and make a Light attack against it.

name: Lightning Charge
tooltip: You turn into a ball of lightning and Sidestep in a straight line to a square within range. You can pass through units while doing so and may make a Light attack against each unit you pass through. This attack deals Lightning damage.

name: Lion's Roar
tooltip: All enemies within range must make a Save or become Unbalanced. They also become Slowed until the end of your next turn.

name: Luck Surge
tooltip: The target must reroll their roll. Can not be used on a roll that was already rerolled.

name: Lucky Dodge
tooltip: You may Sidestep 5ft and the attack against you automatically misses. Roll a d20. If you roll 11 or higher, you recover 2 RP.

name: Lucky Hit
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If the attack hits, it is automatically a critical hit.

name: Lucky Lass
tooltip: You shoot a golden coin at an enemy, making a Light attack against the target that deals 2d10 Astra damage, but doesn’t receive bonuses from power.

name: Luring Pollen
tooltip: Any creature within range that’s more than 10ft away from the you must make a save. If they fail, they must spend AP on their next turn to move as close to you as possible. Once they are within 5ft of you, the effect ends.

name: Mana Razor Alpha
tooltip: Your melee attacks gain an additional 60ft range. They are still counted as melee attacks and do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Maul
tooltip: You makes a Heavy attack against the target that deals maximum Heavy damage. This attack automatically misses if the target uses the Dodge reaction.

name: Missile Barrage
tooltip: You make a Light attack that deals Arcane damage to all enemies within range.

name: Mounted Charge
tooltip: You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than

name: Nightmare Cage
tooltip: You trap the target in a magical cage and teleport them next to you. The target becomes Stunned. The cage can be targeted by attacks. Attacks against it cannot miss, it has 55 HP, no reactions and has a base guard of 0. When its HP reaches 0 or if your HP reaches 0, the cage is destroyed. When the c

name: Nothing
tooltip: Placeholder ability so site doesn't break

name: Oppressing Glare
tooltip: All enemies must make a save against your potency (10+Focus) or become stricken with irrational fear. While feared, all their attacks targeting you cost +1 AP and you gain +4 to hit against them. This debuff lasts until they hit you or you dodge or block one of their attacks.

name: Perfect Shell
tooltip: You Block a ranged attack, as long as the accuracy roll is below your Dodge value.

name: Poison Bite
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already dazed, it takes 8 full pierce Poison damage instead.

name: Poisonous Bite
tooltip: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target. On damage, the target must succeed on a save or become Weakened until the end of their next turn. A character that is already weakened takes an additional 5 (Light) or 10 (Heavy) full-pierce Poison damage instead.

name: Poltergeist
tooltip: You throw an unattended object within range at a target within range, making either a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack that deals normal listed damage. You do not need to physically interact with the object to throw it.

name: Pounce
tooltip: You may move up to twice your speed towards an enemy and then make 2 AP worth of attacks against them.

name: Queen's Domain
tooltip: You shape the area around you to be like that of your hive. The area within 20ft of you gains the following properties: You gain Tremorsense in your hive area, becoming aware of the exact location of all creatures touching the ground. Any non-flying creature except for you, a devouring swarm or a su

name: Raise Shield
tooltip: Your next Block action against an enemy Challenged by you costs 0 RP.

name: Reposition
tooltip: You choose a Grunt level willing ally within range. That ally may sidestep up to twice their movement speed.

name: Resync Bite
tooltip: You make a light attack against a target within range.

name: Reverberant Frost
tooltip: All frost towers created by ‘Frost Creation: Tower’ within range immediately take action, making their single attack listed in the ability.

name: Rock Crunching Bite
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target. You don’t add your focus to this roll.

name: Self Icicle Nail
tooltip: You curl up into a spike shape and fly towards an enemy. You sidestep to and make a Light attack against an enemy within range.

name: Shards of Ice
tooltip: You fire a shard of ice at every enemy within range, making a Light attack against them that deals Frost damage. This attack gains full-pierce against any enemy that is slowed.

name: Skeletal Arm Sweep
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target and any enemies adjacent to it. On damage, they are knocked back 20ft. If at least 3 arms are still alive, you may repeat this attack against a different target within range.

name: Skeletal Armblade Barrage
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. This attack deals Light damage X amount of times, where X is the amount of arms still alive (Max 4). These are considered separate instances of damage, so you don’t add the damage together before subtracting the guard from it.

name: Skullsplitter
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target.

name: Slice & Dice
tooltip: You may make two Light attacks against the target.

name: Slime Body II
tooltip: You gain Damage Reduction 100 against physical damage from the triggering attack

name: Sludge Blast
tooltip: You fire a blast of black sludge at the enemy. You make a Light attack against the enemy, dealing Astra damage on hit. You may spend 2 AP to make a Heavy or Precise attack instead.

name: SMASH YOU
tooltip: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If the target has less toughness than the Ogre’s power, they become dazed.

name: SMASH YOU MORE
tooltip: After successfully “Dazing” a target with “SMASH YOU” , you make an additional Heavy Attack on the target and on unguarded hit the target is knocked Prone.

name: Snow Assassin
tooltip: The frost maiden may Sidestep up to double her speed. Afterwards, she may make a Heavy attack against a target. If she was hidden from the target before moving, the target cannot react to the attack. Cannot be used in the same turn as Blizzard Walker.

name: Spectral Touch
tooltip: You attempt to attack the soul of the target with a touch, making a Heavy attack against the target.

name: Spore Launch
tooltip: You fire poisonous spores towards an area. All within a 15x15ft area must make a save or take Power full pierce poison damage and become poisoned. The deathcap poison makes the target Sickened while it lasts.

name: Squeeze
tooltip: The target must make a Save or take Heavy damage.

name: Static Field
tooltip: You creater a field of lightning around yourself. Any creature that ends its turn within 5ft of you gains Static X, where X is your power x 2. The range of the field is increased to 10ft during a storm.

name: Stone Form
tooltip: You turn yourself to hardened stone, gaining a +10 guard bonus but becoming unable to take any actions. All attacks made against you automatically hit, but cannot crit. You may cancel this effect at the start of your turn. If used while flying, you drop down to the ground without taking falling dama

name: Summon Beast
tooltip: You summon a Wolf, Boar, Giant Spider or Cheetah (Chosen randomly). This creature is friendly to you and you may direct its actions in combat. It acts at initiative 0. It lasts until the end of the encounter, or until either your or its HP reaches 0 or lower, after which it immediately disappears.

name: Sweep
tooltip: You make a Light attack against all enemies in range. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft.

name: Sweeping Opportunity
tooltip: The target falls prone.

name: Swooping Strike
tooltip: You may Sidestep up to twice your speed. At any point during this movement, you may make a Light attack.

name: Swooping Strike II
tooltip: You may Sidestep up to twice your speed. At any point during this movement, you may make a Heavy attack.

name: Tail Spikes
tooltip: You firee a hail of spikes at a 15x15 ft area, making a Light attack against all enemies within the area. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already Dazed, they instead take 5 poison damage.

name: Tail Swipe
tooltip: You spin around your axis and attack every creature within 10ft of you with a Light attack. On damage, a target is pushed back 15ft.

name: Terrifying Roar
tooltip: All creatures that can hear the roar of the firewyrm must make a save or become Shaken. This effect lasts until the end of combat, or until the target uses 3 AP to remove the effect from themselves.

name: Three Headed Assault
tooltip: You and all other heads make a Light attack against the target. All heads, except for you, that made an attack regain 1 less AP on their turn.

name: Topple Prey
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target falls Prone.

name: Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)
tooltip: Fires a transmutation cannon, unleashing a blast of energy that deals light attack damage. Regardless of if the attack hits or not, the target must make a save against DC 15 or be knocked back 30 feet. If the target hits a wall or another creature, both creatures take heavy attack damage.

name: Transmute Low Wall (Body)
tooltip: Creates a 3ft high wall that counts as difficult terrain. The wall extends up to 120 feet and lasts for 10 minutes, or until Alchemic Flare or Transmute Low Wall are used, causing the wall to crumble.

name: Ultimate Lifeform
tooltip: You remove all stacks of one status effect from yourself.

name: Vine Grab
tooltip: Your vine wraps around the target, rooting it. The vine can be destroyed by attacking it. It has 14 HP and takes double damage from fire damage and Slashing attacks. It cannot make reactions, has 0 guard and attacks against it always hit. A creature can be grabbed by multiple vines at the same time.

name: Vital Flurry
tooltip: You target an enemy within range and begin to rapidly slash at them. Every time you are attacked by anyone, you may make a light attack against the target of this ability. On damage, you recover 4 HP. Lasts until you lose The Blur.

name: Web Spray
tooltip: You make a Light attack against the target that deals no damage, but covers the target in webs. On hit, the target becomes rooted .This effect lasts until the target or an ally spends 4 AP to remove the webbing. If a creature rooted by this ability takes fire damage, the effect also disappears as th

name: Webbing
tooltip: You cover a 30x30ft square surface in webs. All creatures in the webbed area become slowed. The webs last until this ability is used again, or until the webs take fire damage on which they are immediately destroyed. Any creature touching the webbing when it is lit on fire becomes Burning 10. Any cre

name: Zero Impact Generator (Left Arm)
tooltip: Generates a shield with 35 HP that blocks damage to other body parts except the left arm.
